title: PROMPT SENTIMENT: THE CATALYST FOR LLM CHANGE

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring sentiment-induced shifts in political framing and policy discussions by providing positive, neutral, and negative prompts, and analyzing the outputs using sentiment drift analysis and fairness metrics.
